title: Why is it Important to be Consistent with Voice?
use_cases: Use when developing unique dialogue styles for a diverse cast of characters
Implement when auditing a manuscript for narrative coherence and tone
Configure when establishing a brand or persona to build audience trust
Use when evaluating if a character is identifiable without a dialogue tag
content:
Consistency creates trust.

 

Voice consistency creates trust with the reader.

![Share on Twitter](https://nybookeditors.com/assets/images/common/icon--twitter.svg)

Tweet this

 

Your reader is perceptive and will detect the smallest deviation in voice. To create a relationship of trust with your reader, you have to pay attention to voice consistency.

Your goal is to create voices so distinct that each character can be identified without a tag line. If you can accomplish this, congratulations: you’ve successfully created voice consistency.

Let’s take a look at five tips for developing voice consistency.
